    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg, 2)]
    if base is not None and points:
        objh = max(r for r,c in points) - min(r for r,c in points) + 1
